lessons.title: Move around
lessons.how: Middle-drag turns the view, the wheel zooms, hold the right button and press W A S D to fly. Get close to the flag!

lessons.title: Put down blocks
lessons.goal: Build a path to the island
lessons.how: Click Block in the palette (or press 1), then click in the view to put it down. Drag to lay a row. Mario has to be able to walk or jump all the way.

lessons.title: Copy and turn
lessons.goal: Make a staircase up to the ledge
lessons.how: Put a block down, then Ctrl+PgUp copies it one step up - or Shift+D copies, PgUp lifts. Each step at most one jump high.

lessons.title: Paint
lessons.goal: Make the castle grey and the grass green
lessons.how: Click a texture in the palette, then P paints what is selected - or click pieces with the texture in the hand. Shift+click paints a whole floor at once.

lessons.title: Make it fair
lessons.how: Shift+S turns on symmetry: whatever you build on one side is built on the other too. Build something next to the first base.

lessons.title: Rooms
lessons.goal: Build a house with a door
lessons.how: Ctrl+Shift+R is the room tool: drag a rectangle in the view and you get walls with a door gap. Or press B for the house brush and click.

lessons.title: Make it pretty
lessons.goal: Auto-dress the map and give it a mood
lessons.how: Ctrl+B dresses the map (rails, pillars, light). Then pick a weather and mood in Properties - try Sunset glow.

lessons.title: Play it!
lessons.goal: Play your map in the game
lessons.how: F6 puts the map in the game and starts Coop DX (Play in the game in the header). Run, jump and find the star!
